scope: pause-menu / inventory title and prompt graphics: locate and export raw tiles, u16 streams and palettes for human review only

proved_here: the named NitroFS files exist at the listed ROM offsets with the listed SHA-256 digests
each listed pack member parses under the strict rs_format layout
each exported raw-index PNG re-encodes to the exact member bytes
pause_data members 0 and 2 contain legible pre-baked PAUSE lettering
the requested UI strings are absent from the dialogue corpus
inferred_not_proved: which on-screen menu consumes each member (no consumer or VRAM trace)
the 16x16 cell geometry used by the glyph sheets
which tile base the u16 streams index into at run time
any reading of an individual Japanese label in the atlases
that the two u16 streams are BG maps at all
out_of_scope: claiming the Chinese UI is finished
runtime screenshots, emulator runs or hardware checks

negative_findings: Absent from the msgdata.bin dialogue corpus: ゲームをとめる, つぎのページへ, PAUSE. This is only a negative result for the extracted dialogue corpus; other text resources, ARM literals, overlays or graphics remain possible.
Also present *inside dialogue lines* (so not evidence of a UI screen): アイテム (31 hits), せつめい (7 hits). A hit here is ordinary prose use, not a menu label.
